<a id="random_from_timers"></a>
### [`random_from_timers`](../../../../src/engine/random.asm#L6) `$6AD0`

*routine*

Returns in A a random byte. It combines the low and high bytes of CIA 1 timer A and CIA 2 timers A and B.
